source: NASA MODIS Terra MOD13A3.061 monthly vegetation indices, tile h19v04 (LP DAAC)
label: Vegetation index, all land (NDVI)

confidence.note: Mean over all land in the unit (forest, grassland, farmland), so in hilly / mountain units it mostly reflects forest. Good / marginal-quality pixels only; months with < 30 % clear pixels dropped.
